***Elsight’s Halo technology is designed to integrate satellite, cellular and radio communications to reduce single points of failure and operator workload***


**ARLINGTON, Va. — (OCTOBER 14, 2026)** — AeroVironment, Inc. (“AV”) (NASDAQ: AVAV), and Elsight (ASX: ELS) announced a partnership to integrate Elsight’s Halo connectivity technology into AV’s Mayhem™ 10 launched effects system, strengthening communications resilience in complex and contested environments.


The integration will enable Mayhem 10 to intelligently manage multiple communications networks, including satellite, private and public cellular and point-to-point radio, through a single connectivity layer. Elsight’s Halo is designed to intelligently bond multiple available communication links into one resilient connection, adapt to changing network conditions and reduce dependence on any single link without requiring operator intervention.


“Reliable connectivity is critical to mission success, particularly in contested environments,” said Austin Miller


v


ice president and general manager of the loitering munition systems business unit at AV. “Mayhem 10 was built to evolve with the mission. Its open architecture allows us to integrate new capabilities quickly, giving operators more flexibility and resilience as threats and operational demands change.”


The collaboration builds on Mayhem 10’s modular, open architecture, which enables the integration of third-party technologies to expand operational capabilities without redesigning the platform. Integration efforts are underway, with both companies working to advance the combined capability.


“Halo was designed to keep missions going, even as communications conditions change,” said Yoav Amitai, CEO of Elsight. “Integrating our technology with Mayhem 10 will help operators maintain reliable control across changing and contested environments, without the added workload of managing multiple communications links


.”


**About Mayhem 10**


Mayhem 10 is AV’s autonomous, multi-role launched effects system designed to deliver kinetic and non-kinetic capabilities across air, ground and maritime operations. Its modular architecture supports multiple mission payloads, including intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance, electronic warfare, communications relay and precision strike.


**About AV**


AeroVironment (“AV”) (NASDAQ: AVAV) is a defense technology leader delivering integrated capabilities across air, land, sea, space, and cyber. The Company develops and deploys autonomous systems, loitering munitions, counter-UAS technologies, space-based platforms, directed energy systems, and cyber and electronic warfare capabilities—built to meet the mission needs of today’s warfighter and tomorrow’s conflicts. With a national manufacturing footprint and a deep innovation pipeline, AV delivers proven systems and future-defining capabilities at speed, scale, and operational relevance. **About Elsight**


Elsight (ASX: ELS) provides the critical enablement layer for uncrewed vehicles, across air, land and maritime domains. Trusted by leading autonomous systems manufacturers, defense organizations, and public safety agencies worldwide, Elsight supports mission-critical operations, where reliability, mobility, and mission certainty matter most.
